Disabling preprocessing entirely preserves elements the standard preset would remove

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"preprocessing\":{\"enabled\":false}}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<nav>NavSection</nav><p>Paragraph</p>", options: _options)
print(result)
```
